author: Wowhead Staff

title.en: New Glove Enchants Available from Loa-Sealed Rooms in Labyrinth of Kindo'jan
title.es: Nuevos encantamientos de guantes disponibles en las habitaciones Loa-Sealed en el laberinto de Kindo'jan

summary.en: New Glove Enchants Available from Loa-Sealed Rooms in Labyrinth of Kindo'jan...
summary.es: Nuevos encantamientos de guantes disponibles en las habitaciones Loa-Sealed en el laberinto de Kindo'jan...

contentHtml:
New Glove Enchants are available from the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, but they only work in Delves.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


As players rank up their Renown with the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, Loa-Sealed Rooms will become accessible. Each of these rooms contains some Mislaid Curiosities and Sturdy Chests. The Sturdy Chests can only be looted once per account but grant bonus reputation, which will help you rank up faster. For each of the Loa, one of the chests in the Loa-Sealed rooms will contain a multi-use Glove Enchant and a Permanent upgrade to make your Labyrinth runs better.

LoaUnlock RenownPermanent UpgradeGlove Enchant
Akil'zonRank 3 Akil'zon's Swiftness Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Falco Strikes
Jan'alaiRank 5None Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Heat Wave
NalorakkRank 7 Nalorakk's Ferocity Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Ursine's Ironhide
HalazziRank 9 Halazzi's Shroud Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Eye of the Lynx


The Glove enchant items are multi-use and "Binds to Warband", meaning that you can send them to your alts. Alternatively, you can pick up additional copies of these items from Naleidea Rivergleam at the Delve area in Silvermoon City.



These Glove enchants were recently hotfixed to work on Item Level 344 gloves, which now include the Myth 9/6 items from Mythic Coiled Altar and Ula'tek. In addition, these effects briefly worked outside of Delve content but have been fixed as of Thursday morning.

Since these enchants only work in delves, not much theorycrafting has been done, but there are some takeaways from the few logs that they've appeared in:
  • Falco Strikes did 644k damage (0.24%) on a Mythic Ula'tek kill over 10 minutes, which seems quite low for single-target damage.
  • Meanwhile, Eye of the Lynx has ~39% uptime of 107 Haste and Leech on a Mythic Kith'ix kill. However, when this procs, the secondary buff gets applied to the nearest ally, but it appears to target pets, which isn't as great as targeting another player.
In conclusion, without having the firm numbers, these may be the best recommendations for which enchant to use:
  • If you want defensive value, use the shield from Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Ursine's Ironhide
  • If you're looking for damage and you like Haste, use Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Eye of the Lynx
  • Otherwise, use Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art: Heat Wave for some flat AoE damage.

author: Wowhead Staff

title.en: Premade Groups Will Only Match Against Other Premades in WoW: Forever Battlegrounds
title.es: Los grupos prefabricados solo se enfrentarán a otros prefabricados en WoW: Forever Battlegrounds

summary.en: Premade Groups Will Only Match Against Other Premades in WoW: Forever Battlegrounds...
summary.es: Los grupos prefabricados solo se enfrentarán a otros prefabricados en WoW: Forever Battlegrounds...

contentHtml:
In the most recent WoW: Forever podcast, Blizzard revealed that if you queue a Battleground solo, you will not be matched against a premade.





Premade groups will only be matched in Battlegrounds against other premade groups, but if you are wondering about playing with your small group of friends, then fear not, as Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield explained that there will still be a small-group option. This will potentially be around 2-3 players, but that is still being decided.

Battleground Matchmaking was first discussed in Classic in Phase Two of Season of Discovery, when changes to matchmaking meant that premades were less likely to be matched with PuGs. This did come with a caveat whereby, after sitting in the queue for a period of time, the new rules would be ignored. We don't know if that will be the case in WoW: Forever.

title.en: Labyrinth of Kindo'jan Has No Save Points Mid Run
title.es: Laberinto de Kindo'jan no tiene puntos de guardado a mitad de carrera

summary.en: Labyrinth of Kindo'jan Has No Save Points Mid Run...
summary.es: Laberinto de Kindo'yan no tiene puntos de guardado a mitad de carrera...

contentHtml:
The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan does not allow you to save your run between sessions, forcing you to restart every run from the beginning.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


Many players were under the impression that Labyrinths would save your progress between sessions, similar to a Megadungeon. When Patch 12.1.5 launched, players were surprised that you cannot save your run. If you log off for an extended period of time, you will be automatically kicked out and be forced to start over. If you're going for a full clear to get any of the achievements, such as Whose Labyrinth? or Fabled Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan, you need to complete a full run, which take at least 30 minutes (or more if you find bugs).

One of the reasons that players were under the belief that you could save was due to the announcement of Labyrinths in the Patch reveal:
Blizzard
View Original
Venture through them in a single epic session or tackle them piece by piece over time, progressing at your own pace.
This wording also continued into the official Patch Notes. This statement implies that players can do the opposite of a single epic session, aka multiple sessions. This may not have been what Blizzard meant by this statement, or things might have changed in development, but as of right now, there is no saving your run in Labyrinths. You either do it all in one, or finish your run and start again next time.

The system does allow a period of time where players can be logged out before your run ends automatically. This can be useful if you disconnect briefly or need to relog for any reason. When you log back in after a short time, nothing will have changed. However, if you stay logged out for a longer time, the entire instance will reset when you log back in, and you'll find yourself outside the Labyrinth and have to start from scratch.

 


All in all, if you're going for a full clear, make sure to give yourself enough time!

title.en: Many More Labyrinth Fixes - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes
title.es: Muchas más correcciones de laberinto - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)

summary.en: Many More Labyrinth Fixes - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes...
summary.es: Muchas más correcciones de laberinto - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted many more labyrinth fixes in today's Patch 12.1.5 hotfixes!
Blizzard
View Original
Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: Midnight, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Season of Discovery, Burning Crusade Classic, WoW Classic Era, and Hardcore. Some of the hotfixes below take effect the moment they were implemented, while others may require scheduled realm restarts to go into effect. Please keep in mind that some issues cannot be addressed without a client-side patch update. This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

Hotfixes

October 16, 2026

Dungeons and Raids
  • Murder Row
    • Added a visual indicating the safe zone of a barrel during Murder in a Row.
      • Developers’ notes: Recently, we addressed an issue where Zaen Bladesorrow’s Murder in a Row could incorrectly assign a player’s safe spot to a barrel they weren’t hiding behind. With the fix, players must stand closer to a barrel to be protected. To better communicate this change, each barrel will now have a visual indicator showing the radius of the safe area players need to hide behind a barrel during Murder in a Row.
  • The Venomous Abyss
    • The Coiled Altar
      • Fixed an issue where the achievement Watch Out Behind You was unable to be completed by raid groups larger than 20 players.
Labyrinth and Delves
  • Fixed an issue with the “Returning the Bounty” scenario in Jan'alai's Refuge that would occasionally prevent the Pit Boss from spawning in the labyrinth.
  • Fixed an issue that caused Valeera’s Stagger to not function when there was a healer present in the delve or labyrinth.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Scar of Kathra’natir damage over time effect to deal more damage to Valeera than intended.
  • Fixed a rare issue that could cause players to fall through the map in The Speaker's Chamber area of The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan.
  • The Loa-Blessed Wayfarer mount and Loa-Blessed Victory toy are now granted after completing the labyrinth by speaking with Kinduru if they were forgotten to be looted from the Ancestral Bounty chest before leaving.
  • Fixed an issue where some creatures and bosses scaled their health and damage values higher than intended when playing in a group.
  • Fixed an issue where Sha'kuro's Soul Storm could be interrupted before all Unfortunate Souls were defeated, negating the damage window gained from the stun.
  • Fixed an issue where L00T RAID-R Mini could only be used once while inside The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan.

summary.es: Hallow's End Tricky Treat Decor Cuesta Nerfed en un 90%...

contentHtml:
In a late-night hotfix, prices for Hallow's End decor costing Tricky Treats were sharply nerfed, making them significantly more affordable.

Hallow's End begins this upcoming Monday, and players are getting excited about the new decor - but the cost was a little worrying. Tricky Treat can take a while to collect, and with some decor costing upwards of 200 treats previously, collecting everything, let alone multiple copies, would have run players thousands of pieces of candy.
